ranking_diagnostic.interpretation: Algebra on this actual trajectory, not retraining or a causal branch-removal experiment.

conclusions: Continuous bias amplitude reduces the preceding endpoint-prior noise regression, but does not beat the base or temperature-only model on noise.
Prior and uncertainty improvements do not establish better decisions; a single changed_novel seed has 37 wrong primary-evaluation ranking reversals.
Uncertainty may contract without moving the mean. Continuous parameter integration, event identity and re-prioring use the same factual likelihood once.
Branch and concentration gradients are connected; optimizer training has not been performed. Base encoders are still fixed/statistical.
Per-action variances do not identify uncertainty of the action difference without joint covariance; this is a next modeling gap, not implemented here.
